title: An image without app/lib/chat-system-prompt.md can still deploy; gate the deploy on it without touching routing
evidence: T28 (US-15 AC65) makes chat refuse with no model call and sends one Sentry error when the prompt is missing, but nothing stops that image deploying. /healthz stays 200 on purpose: it is the routing check on both apps (fly.toml, fly.edu.toml), so a 503 there would route away from lab import, reminders, admin and hosted MCP too, and docs/deploy-runbook.md:285 records the rolling path shipping a failing /healthz image anyway. Fly docs: only Machine checks are said to stop a deploy (https://docs.fly.io/reference/health-checks/); canary boots one Machine and verifies its health (https://docs.fly.io/launch/deploy); --wait-timeout waits for machines to become healthy (https://docs.fly.io/flyctl/deploy/). Options: (1) a Fly Machine check in fly.toml and fly.edu.toml, which runs on deploy only and does not route; (2) the deploy.yml Health gates step curls a check (a workflow file, Brad's); (3) a separate /healthz/chat that only the deploy step curls and that never touches routing (the owner leans to this one). Nothing built. (H67)
